about: Hand-labelled drafts for measuring the review gate: clean replies and replies with one planted failure each, in English, Malay and Chinese, grounded on the fictional Lumora Works handbook. Change it only by adding a new version file.

cases.email_body: Hi, I've been here three years. How many days of annual leave do I get?
cases.rag_context: 1. Annual leave policy: Employees with less than two years of service receive 14 days of annual leave per calendar year. Employees with two to five years of service receive 18 days. Up to 5 unused days may be carried forward to the next year and must be used by 31 March.
action_items: State the annual leave entitlement for three years of service
cases.draft:
Hi [PERSON_1],

With three years of service you receive 18 days of annual leave per calendar year.

Best regards,
[PERSON_2]

cases.email_body: How long do I have to submit my claim for the Penang trip, and do I need receipts?
cases.rag_context: 6. Travel and expense claims policy: Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the date of the expense, using form EXP-01 on the Claims Portal. Original receipts or clear photos of receipts are required for every item above RM50. Approved claims are paid with the next monthly salary.
action_items: Say how long there is to submit the claim
Say whether receipts are needed
cases.draft:
Hi [PERSON_1],

Please submit the claim within 30 days of the expense using form EXP-01 on the Claims Portal. Receipts, or clear photos of them, are needed for every item above RM50.

Regards,
[PERSON_2]

cases.email_body: Bolehkah saya bekerja dari rumah pada hari Isnin dan Selasa?
cases.rag_context: 5. Remote work policy: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. Monday is an office day for every team, so remote days can only be Tuesday to Friday. Core hours are 10am to 4pm.
action_items: Jawab sama ada boleh bekerja dari rumah pada hari Isnin dan Selasa
cases.draft:
Salam [PERSON_1],

Hari Isnin ialah hari pejabat untuk semua pasukan, jadi kerja dari rumah hanya boleh dibuat dari Selasa hingga Jumaat. Anda boleh bekerja dari rumah pada hari Selasa.

Terima kasih,
[PERSON_2]

cases.email_body: Can I carry my unused leave into next year?
cases.rag_context: 1. Annual leave policy: Employees with less than two years of service receive 14 days of annual leave per calendar year. Employees with two to five years of service receive 18 days. Up to 5 unused days may be carried forward to the next year and must be used by 31 March.
